method: Lines sampled across every scene (Scribe sentences, split by word times where one Scribe sentence holds two speakers). For each line 4 frames evenly spaced over the line (runs/gt/H41fJJJYTqo/frames_spk/h_*.jpg, plus dense_924.jpg at 1.5 fps for 924-942 s) were checked for who is on screen and whose mouth moves, combined with content (names used, who answers whom, story logic). Speaker decided before looking at Scribe labels; Scribe label (majority word speaker by time overlap) added afterwards.

label_conventions.speaker: character name from the list; 'OFFSCREEN:<name>' = the speaker is not visible during the line (voice-over, other end of a phone call not shown, reaction shot held on a listener, title card) but is identified from content/voice context; 'UNKNOWN' = cannot tell. For diarization scoring, strip the OFFSCREEN: prefix.
label_conventions.confidence: 3 = seen speaking and/or unambiguous from content; 2 = likely (frames ambiguous, e.g. wide shot or cut mid-line, content supports); 1 = guess
label_conventions.times: seconds in the episode audio; keyed by time, not by Scribe line id

hard_cases: Opening scene (0:32-1:20) is Akshara and Ekta (curly hair, eating the biryani), not the rich roommate as the episode map says.
6:00-6:20 ('చెప్పేశానులే... low class mentality... నీ range తగ్గిపోతుంది') is Ekta flattering Dhana on screen, not a friend on the phone as the map says; Dhana answers 'నా range తగ్గిపోతుంది'.
Ekta's inner-voice asides (8:51, 10:01) and Meenakshi's aside (9:11) are spoken with lips closed; labelled as the thinking character.
Akshara's memory (4:14-4:32) is voice-over: the parent's lines are OFFSCREEN:Akshara's parent, Akshara's own lines are Akshara (she is on screen but not lip-syncing).

15:25-15:38: frames show Akshara asks Meenakshi to go alone ('please నువ్వు వెళ్ళవా? నేను పైకి వెళ్తాను'), so 'నాకు కొంచెం mood బాలేదులే' is Akshara (after being thrown out of the hall), not Meenakshi as the map says; 'అదేంటి నువ్వు అప్పుడే వచ్చేసావ్' is played over an insert of the stalker and assigned to Meenakshi by content (confidence 2).
Phone call 6:48-7:10: the man's lines are those spoken while the cut is on him; Scribe merges both sides into one sentence, so the lines were split by word times.
2:40 'ఎంతసేపు తింటావు దాన్ని' is spoken over the black EPISODE 01 card; assigned to Dhana by content, confidence 1.
